The [Material Library](/materials/) is a CSV file, one row per material. To add materials, fill in the template in Excel or Google Sheets, one row each, save it as CSV and send it in.

<LinkButton href="/templates/material-library-template.csv" download icon="download" iconPlacement="start">Download the Template</LinkButton>

## The Columns

| Column | What Goes in It |
|---|---|
| Material | What it is, such as Aluminum Sheet 5052-H32. A row without one is skipped. |
| Category | A group for the library and the Estimator's totals, such as Metals, Plastics or Vinyl. |
| Thickness | With its unit, such as `0.125 in`. |
| Finish | Such as Mill, Clear or Color to match. |
| Size | The stock size, such as `4 ft x 8 ft` or `48 in x 50 yd roll`. |
| Unit | How it's priced: `LF`, `SF`, `SY`, `CF`, `CY`, `EA`, `LB`, `TON`, `GAL` or `LS`, as in the [Estimator](/templates/estimator/). |
| Unit Price | Dollars per unit, with or without the `$`. |
| Supplier | Who it comes from. |
| Notes | Anything else. |

Only Material is required. On an Estimator sheet, a library material is named by its Material, Thickness and Finish, and its Size, Supplier and Notes go in the row's Notes.
